summary: You pitch your project in five sentences or a 60-second voice note, check it against six key points (problem, what you built, proof, a decision, what is not real, what next), and look at a table that matches every claim with the command or output behind it and says which claims were never run.
goal: Pitch your project in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note.

items.text: Write your two-line answer to the friend's question without notes
Pitch your project in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note

Cut or mark any claim you cannot back up and save your five sentences
